newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAUMA HOME OFFER OVERSUBSCRIBED - UPM.
newsitem.headline: RAUMA HOME OFFER OVERSUBSCRIBED - UPM.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group UPM-Kymmene Oy said on Wednesday a domestic retail offering of shares in engineering group Rauma Oy had been oversubscribed and was now closed.
"The Rauma Oy Finnish retail offering was closed today at 12.30 p.m. (0930 GMT) due to oversubscription," UPM-Kymmene said in a statement.
UPM-Kymmene repeated an earlier announcement that the size of the retail offering to Finnnish retail investors had been increased to 990,000 shares from 300,000 shares due to "good demand."
UPM-Kymmene earlier set the price of its total 10.5 million share offering of Rauma shares at 113.50 markka per share.
